# Importable branch rules

These JSON files are proposed, importable repository protections for Pep. They
are intended to be imported or recreated in GitHub **Settings > Rules >
Rulesets**; they are not active merely because they are committed here.

If imported and enabled, the default branch would require changes to arrive
through a pull request, prevent branch deletion and force-pushes, and allow
squash merges. The signed-commits file would require signed commits on all
branches. Adjust the bypass actors and enforcement level for your team before
enabling these rules.
